intervention_description: A multifaceted program targeting ultra-poor households with productive asset transfer, consumption support, technical skills training, high-frequency home visits, savings access, and health services/education

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Weekly or monthly cash stipend to stabilize consumption and reduce incentives to sell productive assets
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Health education, basic health services, and/or life-skills training
graduation_components_rationale.assets: One-time transfer of productive asset chosen by household
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Technical training on managing productive assets and general life skills
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Access to savings accounts and deposit collection services
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: High-frequency home visits providing accountability and encouragement
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Village assistance committees and group activities

outcomes.literal_text: Per capita consumption increases by 0.12 SDs (q-value 0.001), which is equivalent to PPP US$4.55 per capita per month
